name: Storm

abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Storm için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Storm's control of the elements grants her Immunity to Shock effects.

abilitySections.title: Prowess Buffs
content: Unless otherwise stated, Storm's Prowess Buffs last 20 seconds and grant +20% Special Attack damage.
Each time either Champion lands a Critical Hit, gain 1 Prowess Buff(s).
Each time the opponent Purifies a Debuff, gain 2 Prowess Buff(s).
Each time Storm gains a Bleed effect, gain 2 Prowess Buff(s).
Each time Storm's Immunity prevents a Shock effect, gain 2 Prowess Buff(s).

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: If a Skill Opponent Purifies a Stun Debuff it is replaced with a Passive Stun lasting 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: While charging or launching a Heavy Attack, all Prowess effects on Storm are Paused. Knocking the opponent down with this attack Pauses all Prowess effects on Storm for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit has a 70% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff, causing [5,279.5] Energy Damage over 6 seconds.
If the opponent is Stunned, the Shock chance becomes 100% and all Shocks on the opponent are Paused for 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Final hit: 100% chance to inflict a 3 second(s) Stun Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to gain a non-stacking Precision Buff, increasing Critical Rating by +[1,178.57] for 45 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Conduit
content: Launching a Special Attack grants Storm 1 Prowess Buff per level of Special Attack used. Additionally, each Prowess on Storm, to a maximum of 10, increases the Potency of her Shock Debuffs by +[8 - 18]%.
